swhid.reason: Official Software Heritage swh.model locally computed standard intrinsic content/directory SWHIDs without network archive dependency.

bagitTransfer.reason: LoC bagit-python produced SHA-256 BagIt transfer package and passed fresh reopen validation for all 86 files.

formalFormatIdentification.reason: FIDO 1.6.1 executed successfully but its bundled/updater signature set is PRONOM v109, stale relative to newer current signature sets. Extension-only matches are never promoted.

bagitZipToA3m.reason: Standards composition avoids a3m hidden-file deletion without unstable workflow patch: exact source roots -> BagIt -> ZIP -> a3m. All 86 frozen files were verified as PREMIS-original subset by SHA-256/size, including all 3 hidden files.

a3mProductionAuthority.reason: Upstream a3m 0.8.1 is proof-of-concept and its stable CLI cannot disable hidden-file removal. It is accepted as an AIP-engine feasibility result only.

productionPreservationEngine.reason: Production authority must still be tested against the same corpus before bulk migration of 302 works.

externalReplacementConsequences: Do not create an Ordivon-native software persistent-identifier scheme; store SWHID alongside local Git resolution context.
Do not create a custom transfer/fixity package schema; use BagIt.
Freeze custom AIP/PREMIS-event ontology growth; external preservation engines demonstrably generate BagIt AIP + METS/PREMIS.
Keep Creative Library suffix mapping presentation-only; formal format identity remains external and ungraduated until current PRONOM tooling is admitted.
Do not patch a3m hidden-file workflow. Use standards packaging for the pilot; use configurable production Archivematica/Enduro or another mature repository after comparative acceptance.
truthBoundary: This acceptance proves the external standards composition on a 12-work/86-file heterogeneous local corpus. It does not prove long-term repository operations, E-ARK conformance, off-machine durability, current-complete PRONOM identification, production maturity of a3m, Human/artistic quality, gameplay correctness, or physical realization.
